data.title: 泽塔 · 窗边的猫式午睡
data.description: 据点的窗边，午后阳光正好。泽塔抱着靠垫蜷成一团睡着了，耳朵偶尔轻轻抖一下——就算睡着，金豹的警觉也没有完全放下。
data.location: hideout window seat with cushions, afternoon sunlight and a view of rooftops
data.action: curled up asleep on a window seat hugging a cushion, cat ears twitching slightly in her sleep
data.promptProse: Curled on the window seat with a cushion, Zeta sleeps — ears still twitching at every third sound.
data.animaCaption: Even asleep, a Shadow Garden cat sleeps with one ear open.
